candidates.change_summary: Change the required msg.value from 10 ether to 9 ether, altering when the fallback accepts calls and thus changing pastBlockTime updates observable via fallback.
Remove the time-ordering requirement so fallback can update pastBlockTime regardless of timestamp comparison, changing observable state after calls that previously reverted.
Set pastBlockTime to block.timestamp (instead of block.timestamp + 1), changing the stored value observable after a successful fallback call.
Always transfer contract balance to sender (remove the block.number % 15 condition), which can change observable state and balances after fallback calls.
Invert the block condition so transfer occurs when block.number % 15 != 0, altering when balances change and thus observable behavior.
Change assignment to add 2 instead of 1, setting pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 2 and thus changing the stored value observed after the call.
